notes.title: Localization Update Beta testing
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4471291/681b2bfac79c48050ce06a3de90db68169ba5c32.png[/img]

There is a new windows build to the beta branch that we would love people to try out before we push it out to everyone. This update adds localization support for 14 new languages. Many thanks to @YellowAfterlife (netcode dev) for his support and tooling here! 

It's also built from the latest version of game maker, which potentially will make the game run faster due to all the performance updates the software has received over the years, but will also likely cause some bugs in the game. We've been playing this version of the game and haven't encountered anything weird, but please let me know if you run into anything while playing. 

To try it out you will have to opt into the beta branch by right clicking the game and selecting "properties", then "betas", then select the beta channel from the dropdown (see attached pic). When you first open the game it will set the language to your default os language (if supported) but you can override that in the options menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4471291/f9e8022cafa17be578c9ffea57e1d7a4c6ccc79c.png[/img]

If you're looking for online opponents and the matchmaker is empty, check out the official Nidhogg discord! https://discord.gg/nidhogg We have a matchmaking channel there where you can message all owners of the game.

If you encounter a bug, you can let us know here or via email at support@nidhogggame.com 

Thanks

notes.title: Menu Screen Crash Hotfix 9/18/17
notes.content:
Just set build id 2129021 live! This update fixes a crash that started happening suddenly on the Main Menu screen when the game fetched highscores. We're not sure why this code stopped working a few years in, my best guess is that something with Windows/Steam changed! For the moment, I've just set it so that if the highscores don't fetch properly the game can recover. Unfortunately this means the highscores wont show up at all for the time being. We're still looking into this!

Many thanks to those who alerted me to this over email, twitter, and discord. If you would like to join our Discord community, head over here-- https://discord.gg/nidhogg

Welcome to all the new players!

notes.title: Netplay + Matchmaking update
notes.content:
Hey Everyone

We have been working with Vadim @yellowafterlife on another update to the netcode-- this time addressing matchmaking and some customization features that players wanted. You can now pick a specific opponent out of all the players wanting to play, or just run matchmaker and it will decide for you. The matchmaker should now more accurately show how many players are looking to play (you count as one of them!) You can also toggle variants and chat to your opponent during the match.

Please direct all bug reportsto the our Steam discussion board "bug reports" subforum-- http://steamcommunity.com/app/94400/discussions/1/

Thanks for the continued support! We can't wait to share Nidhogg 2 with you all! http://store.steampowered.com/app/535520/Nidhogg_2/
ːnidhoggyengardeː

notes.title: Multiplayer Update Now Live
notes.content:
ːnidhoggyengardeː Hey Everyone ːnidhoggoengardeː

We are super excited to unleash a big update for Nidhogg's online multiplayer functionality!!

We have been working with another programmer, Vadim Dyachenko (@yellowafterlife), to improve the latency and desync issues in the online multiplayer mode of Nidhogg. 

Rather than having a set frame delay on the inputs, the new system sets the delay based on your connection. Remember that a connection is only as fast as the slowest player!

Matchmaking has also been sped up a bit and various graphical bugs that could crash the game have been fixed.

The current build ID for the update for mac+pc is 710182. If you want to confirm that you have the update, check preferences > local files and make sure you have a number the same or bigger than that.

We really appreciate your patience during this process, and hope to see you on a more equal online playing field.

ːnidhoggsːːnidhoggsːːnidhoggsːːnidhoggsːːnidhoggsːːnidhoggsːːnidhoggː  ːnidhoggyrunː

-Mark
